biocs.name: PowerShell Process with Unicode Obfuscation
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell processes that use Unicode character substitution in command line arguments
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains '0x50006f007700650072005300680065006c006c002e006500780065'

abiocs.name: Unicode Substitution in PowerShell Command Line
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where PowerShell command line arguments contain Unicode-encoded strings indicating obfuscation
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_command_line matches '0x[0-9a-fA-F]{2,}'

xql_queries.name: Detect Unicode Obfuscated PowerShell Commands
